interpretation_ceiling: Reference point of the municipality as published by the IGN: a point placed as centrally as possible inside the municipality's main population nucleus. It is not the centroid of the municipal territory and not an administrative boundary. Used only to place published origin municipalities on a map; it carries no tourism, population or flow information.
